decision.explanation: The provided documents contain conflicting assertions regarding the formation year of the '24th Rifle Division' (specifically the 1st Simbirsk Infantry Division which became the 24th). Document 1 (D1S3) states it was formed on July 26, 1918. Document 2 (D2S3) states it was formed on January 1, 1920. Both sources explicitly link the formation event to the entity in question. Per the instruction to keep supported alternate referents and treat competing assertions as potentially distinct valid answers (or unresolved conflicts requiring both), both years are retained as valid extracted answers from the source text.
